title: Level text
doc: Per-level voice lines and subtitles (<level>_text.tbl), numbered 0 to 63; there are no section headers.

sections.doc: Rows of a number, a quoted sound file, then either En:, Gr: and Fr: texts or one quoted text, read until the end of the file.

columns.doc: En: "..." Gr: "..." Fr: "..." (each up to 1023 characters), or a single quoted text
